title: New OSSTMM 4 pre release at the ICIST Conference
description: The OSSTMM 4 pre-release was announced and streamed live at the ICIST Conference in Lithuania, with a public release planned for December 1, 2026. OSSTMM (Open Source Security Testing Methodology Manual) is a framework for security testing and analysis. This announcement is informational and does not describe a specific security vulnerability or threat.
